newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' mixed, less offerings by Hind Zinc.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' mixed, less offerings by Hind Zinc.

text.p: Indian zinc prices showed modest gains on Wednesday while other base metals were steady or unchanged in a narrow price band, dealers said.
Ready zinc rose 25 rupees to 6,225 rupees per quintal on stray physical support and restricted offerings by the government's Hindustan Zinc Ltd.

Nickel was steady at 37,800 rupees. Copper was unchanged at 11,750 rupees and lead at 4,925 rupees. State agencies have kept copper, zinc and leads selling prices unchanged for the second half of the current month, one dealer said.
Tin was steady at 35,600 rupees and aluminium at 7,250.
